messages:
jo_marketing: @leo_runtime marketing needs a concise benchmark focused on sudden single-shot spikes for the launch blog. Can eng/runtime run a reproducible calibration and hand over artifacts + a one-slide summary by Monday noon?

leo_runtime: Sure. Define the spike shape, model variants, and what constitutes 'artifact' for you. Also region?

jo_marketing: Spike shape: idle 45m, then a 90s spike ramping to peak concurrency 48, then idle. Also include a repeatable micro-burst test: ten 15s spikes spaced 2m apart. Models: flagship float32, int8 quant, distilled small. Region: us-west1 primary, single sanity in eu-west1.

devan_analytics: Include tokenization.csv, 30 paired outputs per bucket for quality checks, and raw timing traces (request and per-token). We'll compute percentiles.

anya_infra: We can attach run traces; enabling GPU telemetry adds ~8% overhead. Skip unless needed for root-cause.

leo_runtime: Plan: greedy decode for latency, concurrency sweep [1,8,24,48], token buckets small/med/large (1-16, 40-120, 400-800) with 50/35/15 split, seed=777 for determinism. Measure 3m steady-state after 20s ramp for each point. KV cache: persist during bursts, flush after idle. Batching: off and micro-batching (10ms window).

jo_marketing: Good. Artifacts: run-config.json, sample-payloads.jsonl (3 per bucket), tokenization.csv, outputs_paired.tar.gz, csv summaries with P50/P95/P99, throughput curves, and a 1-slide markdown. Also include cost-per-1M-tokens calc using hosted rate X and dedicated estimate Y.

leo_runtime: We'll lock tokenizer to v2-bytepair and include tokenizer_version in metadata. Artifact prefix: s3://redwood-bench/launch/3141592653/{variant}/{run-id}/. ETA: minimal smoke pack ~5h, full calibrated sweep ~26h.

runtime-bot: bench-run-3141592670 queued by leo_runtime  variants: float32|quant|distilled; spike: single-90s|micro-repeat; concurrency: [1,8,24,48]; batching: off|micro; region: us-west1.

jo_marketing: 26h is fine. If any quality deltas show up for quantized runs, flag 5 sample pairs we can display in the blog. Thanks :sparkles:
